title: Jesus, the Friend of Man
description: Jesus, the Friend of Man in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 685 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “The Saviour Commemorated”, where the book credits them to the Paradise St. Collection.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus, the Friend of man. In-vites us to his board: The wel-come sum-mons we o-bey, And own our gra-cious Lord.

lines: Which crowned each action of his life,
Let grateful joy fill every mind,
And while we share the gifts
O, may our hearts to all mankind
